dedupe_keys.name: rsil remote sensing industrial land dataset annotated 0 8 m images of industrial land in china

description: RSIL is a remote sensing dataset for detecting industrial land. The Zenodo record says it has 1,389 images at 0.8 metre resolution, each 512 by 512 pixels, from ten regions across several provinces and municipalities of China, with ground-truth bounding boxes marking industrial land. It was published on 12 June 2026 by Yuling Wu, Xiyu Jin, Ruiqian Zhang and Qingyu Li as one zip file of about 1.3 GB (named for a vision-language grounding study), free to download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the ten sampled Chinese regions. Caveats: the regions, image source and dates are not stated on the page read, the author affiliations are not given, and boxes mark land use, not individual plants or their type. For simulation it gives training data to map industrial land from imagery, where factory inventories are missing, as an exposure layer for flood and earthquake risk to industry. Related catalogue records include the industrial smoke plume images, the Hotmaps industrial sites and the China industrial corrosion failure cases.
